relocation_normalization.reason: Stock and candidate use different module-specific .rodata and allocation-tag offsets; symbol identities, strings and call targets are equivalent.

known_safety_observation: The stock vmalloc failure path calls memset with the still-null buffer pointer; the harness instruments this call without dereferencing null.
limitations: The zlog client, allocator, printk and notification transport are stubbed.
No smartphone, SPI, firmware transport or physical hardware was used.
